eligibility_criteria: 1. Candidate shall have passed a Bachelor’s degree in Pharmacy from a PCI approved institution.2. Minimum of 50% aggregate of marks in Bachelor’s Degree.3. Students should submit Pharmacist Registration Certificate obtained from the respective state pharmacy council at the time admission.4. Age: Minimum age limit is 21 years on or before 31st December of year of Admission.
about_program: Postgraduate M.Pharm programme offered by SRM Institute of Science and Technology in Pharmaceutical Analysis.
